name: ca-study
description: Evidence-first crypto buy ratings with mandatory fixed-format tokenomics, explicit revenue recipients and ratio bases, holder capture, and a five-line verdict.

interface.longDescription: Every asset assessment includes a fixed tokenomics block: supply/circulation, version-specific revenue splits, profit or retained-revenue routing, buyback mechanism/current ratio, and burn mechanism/current ratio. Every percentage names its denominator, recipient, purpose, token and evidence scope; unknowns remain visible. Tokenomics retains 35/30/25 points for operating applications, early applications and memes. Keep early relative-value entries, meme catalysts, holder-profit and launch-bundle checks, and the final five-line A/B/C/D/F verdict.
defaultPrompt: 研究这个 CA，强制按代币经济固定格式写总量/流通百分比、逐版营收分配、利润分配、回购机制/当前回购比例、销毁机制/当前销毁比例；每项写清分母、分给谁、用途、代币及核查状态，缺项写未核实，收入用途比例与累计回购/销毁供应占比分开。
分析这个 CA：发射台、主池、配对资产、合约权限、团队与风险。
查币股配对是否官方，分红是否真实，并介绍底层股票。
结合当前市值评级：Meme 看未来一周催化、1–2 个月机会和发射台支持；早期应用比较同类估值，评估小仓买预期；最后以五行文本给出评级、赔率和买入策略。
重点核验代币分配、真实流通、解锁增发、销毁/回购/分红比例与实际兑现，说明净稀释和持币收益如何改变当前买入评级。
